input.summary: Add Licensee convenience termination on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and bar Licensor convenience termination during the term.
input.comment: [Playbook] The 36-month term gives us no exit right at all, so we have added our standard convenience termination on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirmed Licensor cannot walk away for convenience during the term. If helpful, we can move to 60 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, in which case Licensor shall refund to Licensee, pro rata, any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any extension thereof.
